faq-what-we-do.a: We are a B2B IT company based in Tashkent. We build infrastructure, automate processes, develop software, and train teams.

faq-response-time.a: During business hours — within one hour. On MSP contracts — per SLA.

faq-pricing-model.a: Fixed bids for scoped projects. Monthly MSP contracts for ongoing support. Time & material for consulting.

faq-project-timeline.a: From 2 weeks for an MVP to 3–6 months for enterprise systems. We commit to specifics after the audit.

faq-data-security.a: NDA, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege access, audit. Sensitive systems can be on-premise.

faq-payment-terms.a: Staged: deposit, milestone payments, final. MSP is billed monthly.

faq-post-launch-support.a: Yes. Free warranty period, then MSP or pay-per-ticket support.

faq-nda.a: Yes, always. We can use your template or provide ours.
